title: 16-Inch Triple Tier Glass Shelf With Integrated Towel Bar (Wall Mount, Solid Brass Hardware) | Sea Foam Green | Allied Brass
body_html:
Clear counter clutter and keep towels within reach with a wall-mounted glass shelf made for everyday bathroom organization in Sea Foam Green, which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces. With three tiers and an integrated towel bar, it adds storage where you need it while fitting traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.

  • Sea Foam Green transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Keep towels ready with the integrated towel bar for daily or decorative towels
  • Maintain a clean look on the wall with concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Coordinate your bath with a piece that complements heritage bathroom fixtures

Specs & Installation

  • Glass size: 16 x 5 inches
  • Overall size: 16 in L x 18 in H x 5 in W
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8 in)
  • Weight capacity: 6 lb
  • Material: Brass (solid brass hardware)
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screws: #8 x 1 1/4)
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.description: Add space and organization to your bathroom with this simple, contemporary style glass shelf. Featuring tempered, beveled-edged glass and solid brass hardware this shelf is crafted for durability, strength and style. Integrated towel bar provides space for your favorite decorative towels or for your everyday use. One of the many coordinating accessories in the Allied Brass Collection of products, this subtle glass shelf is the perfect complement to your bathroom decor.
